```python
# filename: oldest_disc_item.py
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

file_path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/32102e3e-d12a-4209-9163-7b3a104efe5d.xlsx'

df = pd.read_excel(file_path, skiprows=2)
markers = ['DVD','Blu-Ray','VHS']
# Build a Section column by forward filling marker titles
sec = []
current = None
for t in df['Title']:
    tt = str(t).strip() if pd.notna(t) else ''
    if tt in markers:
        current = tt
        sec.append(current)
    else:
        sec.append(current)

df['Section'] = sec
# Map to broader groups
map_group = {'DVD':'Disc','Blu-Ray':'Disc','VHS':'Tape'}
df['Group'] = df['Section'].map(map_group)

# Filter Disc rows (exclude the marker rows themselves)
disc_df = df[(df['Group']=='Disc') & (~df['Title'].isin(markers))].copy()
# Convert Year to numeric
disc_df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(disc_df['Year'], errors='coerce')
# Get oldest non-null year
oldest_year = disc_df['Year'].min()
oldest_candidates = disc_df[disc_df['Year']==oldest_year]
# Take first title as per appearance
ans = oldest_candidates['Title'].iloc[0] if not oldest_candidates.empty else None
print(ans)
```
